definitions.gloss: masterpiece, major work, epic, magnum opus
definitions.explanation: A large-scale or significant creative work, such as a novel, film, painting, or musical composition. Emphasizes the scale and ambition of the work rather than necessarily its quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大作|たいさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read his latest major work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{大作|たいさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an epic film that runs over three hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}させた→完成させる：02519_kanseisaseru⟧{大作|たいさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The major work that the painter spent ten years completing was exhibited at the museum for the first time.

notes:
{大作|たいさく} emphasizes the scale and ambition of a creative work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大作|たいさく}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: epic film, blockbuster
- {大作|たいさく}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: major novel
- {超|ちょう}{大作|たいさく}: mega-production, blockbuster
- ⟦{渾身|こんしん}→渾身：13349_konshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大作|たいさく}: a work poured one's heart into

USAGE:
{大作|たいさく} focuses on scale (length, scope, ambition) rather than quality. A {大作|たいさく} is not necessarily a ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧ (masterpiece in terms of quality), though the two often overlap.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece (emphasis on quality and acclaim)
- {大作|たいさく}: major work (emphasis on scale and ambition)
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧: masterwork (emphasis on excellence)
